kanzAlMahalliRecord.scope: All son-line levels, nearer-male blocking, lower-male rescue, fixed ceilings, and 2:1 residue.

khulasaRecord.scope: All son-line levels and examples including daughter, son's daughter, and son's son's son.

sourceAgreement.detail: Both Shafi'i sources state the same generation hierarchy and lower-male rescue boundary.

conditions: Only an unbroken male line before the final male/female descendant is valid.
Nearer male descendants exclude lower descendant levels.
The rescuing male gives two units per eligible male and one per eligible female.
exclusions: Multiple unequal female fixed-share levels are not generalized in this admission pass.
